description: This PHP source file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI class for the OrangeHRM application. It provides RESTful API endpoints for managing reporting method configurations, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting reporting methods within the HRM system. The class extends core API endpoint classes and uses annotations for OpenAPI documentation. It interacts with the ReportingMethodConfigurationService and ReportingMethod entity, handling validation, serialization, and error handling related to reporting method configurations.
